text:
elaine: FYI after enabling <<END_ARGS>> sentinel on zephyr-int4 and sablev2-int8 canaries we saw per-canary collision events (model actually emitted sentinel inside a string) ~0.01% which is higher than expected for production. sharing quick notes.
raju: can you paste a collision example? curious if its always inside quoted content or also as part of generated metadata.
elaine: pasted raw. note the sentinel ends up inside a quoted description, which fooled the sentinel-scan: 
```
{"tool":"annotate","args":{"text":"User said: \"please end with <<END_ARGS>> so we can parse\"","meta":{...}}}
<<END_ARGS>>
```
maria: gah. thats annoying. telemetry from canary?
canary-bot: Run 1775554200: sentinel_collision_rate=0.012%, schema_fail_rate=0.11% (pre-sentinel baseline=0.34%), affected=[zephyr-int4,sablev2-int8], parse_err_count=88
ops-ci: small wins: sentinel dropped overall schema failures dramatically, but collisions mean false-negatives where parser believes it has complete JSON. we can tighten sentinel rules: require sentinel on its own line, no surrounding quotes, and a short TTL after which any extra bytes are logged and trimmed.
raju: also run tokenizer-safety scan: iterate common tokenizers and candidate sentinel strings to check subtokenization collisions. I prototyped a scan: pick sentinel candidates from the training-safe vocabulary (e.g. "</s>__END__", "<|end-args|>") and score by probability of being generated given sampled prompts.
elaine: results of scan showed "</s>__END__" had near-zero collision across zephyr/sable tokenizers, while raw "<<END_ARGS>>" splits in some vocabularies and appears in samples. recommend switching to suffix sentinel using closed-vocab token.
maria: operational guard: when sentinel detected, require second-check: parse JSON up to sentinel, then run golden-set validations (required keys and types) before accepting. if validation fails, trigger auto-retry with batch=1 and token_cutoff+=128.
ops-ci: implementable quick patch: 1) change sentinel to token-based `</s>__END__` and require newline isolation 2) add golden-set validator for canary 3) log collisions to s3://redwood-canaries/sentinels/1775554200/collisions.ndjson 4) enable fallback retry with batch=1 (owner=ops-ci)
raju: long-term: runtime should preserve token boundaries for KVprefix and streaming so sentinel placement is guaranteed. we'll add a kernel-chunking ticket for eng-runtime.
elaine: deployed sentinel change to zephyr-int4 and ran a 2h canary: collision_rate -> 0.0004%, schema_fail_rate -> 0.07%. pushing PR with change and canary flag.
maria: thanks all. will add dashboard split by model variant, tokenizer family, and collision examples count. if collision rate rises above 0.001% we revert sentinel and fallback to heal-json.
raju: filing follow-ups: tokenizer-scan (owner=raju), golden-set coverage expansion (owner=maria), runtime chunking ticket (owner=eng-runtime).
elaine: i'll post the PR link and highlight the tokenizer scan results. :thumbsup:
